author: Little Chinese Everywhere
description:
We have some exciting news to share: we’re launching our own China tours!
If you’ve ever wanted to experience China beyond the guidebooks, come travel with us:
littlechineseeverywhere.com/tours

In this video, we travel to Zhangjiajie to take on one of China's most extreme adventures: the world's longest sky ladder.
At first, I was really hesitant. Standing at the top and looking down, I honestly wasn't sure if I could do it, and eventually decided to stay behind.
But Flo was determined to take on the challenge. So while I watched from above, he climbed thousands of steps into the sky to find out what it was really like.
